_doc: SYNC LEDGER (lockfile) — one record per synced component: the contract hash and canvas fingerprint last known to agree. Written by sync verbs (figma receive --apply, figma publish, sync record/seed, sync observe --update); read by `npm run sync:observe`. Deterministic serialization — regenerate with sync/cli.ts, never hand-order. See sync/README.md.
